name: DeepSight Depth Question Answer Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to rigorously assess multimodal models' understanding of depth maps in three-dimensional scenes. It evaluates spatial reasoning and depth perception capabilities using depth image-text pairs and depth instruction datasets.
reputation: Newly introduced benchmark from a recent paper, so it has limited community adoption so far.
notes: Includes novel depth image-text pair dataset and depth instruction dataset; evaluates depth perception in multimodal models.
